component.name: Lightmorphic Flow
component.summary: Share one mouse, keyboard and clipboard between computers

description.p: Lightmorphic Flow lets one keyboard and mouse drive up to four other computers on the same network, one on each edge of your screen, and keeps the text clipboard in step between them.

It never takes over a screen edge. A light touch on an edge or a corner does nothing at all, so hot corners and hot edges carry on working the way they always did. Only a deliberate, continued push moves the pointer to the next computer. While the pointer is on your own screen nothing is grabbed, so touchpad gestures, pointer speed and every shortcut are untouched.
The computers find each other by themselves, and every link is encrypted.
This is a beta release. Expect rough edges.
The update dot sits opposite the logo again.
A tray icon that shows where the pointer is, lets you send it to any of your computers, and turns sharing on and off.
The update dot follows the house standard exactly.
The application icon and the listing in your software centre.
Finds other computers on the network. Drives up to four at once.
